_comment: Portfolio backlog for /agent-loop. Spans THREE repos around one thesis: anvil-engine is the self-hosted agentic browser that BOTH products run on (no Browserbase/Browserless/Steel). Each iteration: STAGE 0 triage across all streams -> do the single highest-leverage item -> verify -> commit/push -> REFILL (append >=1 new next-step you discovered). STOP only if truly nothing + refill yielded nothing.
thesis: anvil-engine (self-hosted CDP browser) is shared infra. Relay = consumer text-a-bot on anvil. DataFaucet = dev/MCP layer; its capture flow still pays Browserbase — moving it to anvil unifies the stack and removes the vendor. Synergy: one browser engine, two products, zero browser vendor.

repos.relay: C:/Users/acwic/relay (awictor/relay, branch main) — consumer Telegram agent. MVP DONE + live-verified.
repos.datafaucet: C:/Users/acwic/mcp-forge (awictor/mcp-forge, master) — DO NOT touch master. All work on branch anvil-migration behind a feature flag; prod stays on Browserbase until Alex merges.
repos.anvil: C:/Users/acwic/anvil-engine (awictor/anvil-engine, main) — the shared browser engine.

invariants: Free services only. Never commit secrets (.env gitignored; grep staged diff before push).

DataFaucet: NEVER commit to master. Use branch 'anvil-migration'; gate every behavior change behind an env flag (e.g. BROWSER_BACKEND=anvil|browserbase, default browserbase) so prod is unaffected until merge.
Verify before done: tsc + tests each repo; real e2e (anvil live at http://localhost:3000) when possible; report call-tested honestly.
$? after a pipe is the pipe's status. Context-mode hook blocks curl — use ctx_execute(fetch) for HTTP probes.
EVERY iteration must REFILL: append >=1 concrete next-step to items[] before finishing, so the loop never dead-ends.

streams.synergy: Wire DataFaucet capture-flow (auto-scan) to anvil as an alternative browser backend behind BROWSER_BACKEND flag. This is the flagship cross-product work — deep well: adapter, session mgmt, live-view, tests, parity with Browserbase.
streams.relay: Extend Relay: more channels (SMS/WhatsApp), richer tools, memory persistence, deploy hardening. Also: dogfood — could Relay consume a DataFaucet-hosted MCP?
streams.anvil: Harden the shared engine: whatever both consumers need (stability, stealth, session limits, observability). Fixes here benefit both products.

owner_blockers: deploy-1 (relay): Oracle Always Free VM for 24/7 (DEPLOY.md). Owner-gated.
DataFaucet prod merge: after anvil-migration branch is proven, Alex decides when to merge + flip the flag.

items.task: DONE (code, flag-gated, prod-safe): anvil backend in auto-scan behind BROWSER_BACKEND=anvil (default browserbase, existing paths untouched). tsc+build clean, pushed to branch anvil-migration. BUT the anvil puppeteer.connect path has a real bug -> see syn-1b.

On anvil-migration: point start/stop/debug browser routes' backend selection at the flag too (session create + teardown + live-view). anvil live-view is /v1/view (MJPEG) — map it where Browserbase debug URL was used. Keep browserbase default. Verify a real auto-scan via anvil locally (anvil on :3000) returns captured endpoints.

PARTIAL: extracted capture-filter.ts (isNoise/isApiRequest/redactUrlParams/filterHeaders) shared by both backends + 7 unit tests wired into gate (1769 green). Branch anvil-migration b15922d5. STILL TODO for syn-3: document BROWSER_BACKEND in .env.local.example + write the PR description for the eventual master merge (do NOT merge).
Persist per-chat memory across restarts (currently in-memory Map, lost on restart). Simple JSON file or sqlite; bounded. Unit-test load/save. Keeps the agent context after a redeploy.
Confirm /v1/metrics exposes session counts + latency both products can monitor; add anything missing. Low priority until a real deploy exists.

PARTIAL: fixed a real cdp-proxy bug (buffer client CDP msgs until Chrome ws opens, anvil 216d927) but puppeteer.connect still fails Target-closed — deeper browser-level relay issue. DOWNGRADED: HAR capture path (syn-1c) supersedes this for the DataFaucet migration, so puppeteer.connect is no longer on the critical path. Revisit only if a future need requires live CDP driving.

DONE + VERIFIED LIVE: HAR-based capture in auto-scan for BROWSER_BACKEND=anvil. har/start -> crawl via /v1/actions/navigate + link-discovery via evaluate -> har/stop -> GET /v1/har -> shared processRequest() (same NOISE/isApi/redact/dedup as puppeteer path). Default browserbase path unchanged. Ran DataFaucet :3100 in anvil mode vs jsonplaceholder (10 pages) -> captured endpoint via HAR, zero Browserbase, no puppeteer.connect. Branch anvil-migration b827cfd1.

DONE: anvil HAR was flat (url/method/status/size/timing only — no headers/body). ENHANCED anvil (4271aeb) so HAR entries now include requestHeaders + requestBody(postData) + resourceType. Verified live: 17 request headers on a doc fetch. anvil HAR entry shape: {url,method,status,duration,responseSize,timestamp,requestHeaders:{}, requestBody?:string, resourceType}. This gives DataFaucet capture everything it needs (auth headers + POST bodies), unblocking syn-1c.

DONE: switched default model to gemini-flash-lite-latest (higher free cap) + automatic model FAILOVER in GeminiClient — on 429/403 quota it advances through a chain (lite -> flash-latest -> 2.5-flash-lite -> 2.5-flash), each with its own free quota; transient 503/504/500 still retry w/ backoff on the same model. GEMINI_MODELS env overrides the chain. 3 failover unit tests. 23/23 green.

anvil HAR: also record response content-type + (optional, capped) response body preview, so DataFaucet can classify JSON endpoints without a second fetch. Low priority — url/headers/method already enough for capture.

Harden anvil HAR capture: (1) verify vs a real API-heavy SPA (jsonplaceholder homepage is static -> only 1 endpoint captured); (2) the puppeteer path clicks safe buttons to trigger more XHRs — anvil path only navigates+reads links; decide if anvil needs click-through via /v1/actions/click behind a DANGEROUS guard, or if nav-only is acceptable.

Finish syn-3: (1) add BROWSER_BACKEND + ANVIL_BASE_URL + ANVIL_API_KEY to .env.local.example with a note (default browserbase, set anvil to self-host); (2) write anvil-migration PR body summarizing the flag-gated anvil path (auto-scan HAR capture + shared capture-filter), how prod stays on browserbase until merge, and the anvil puppeteer.connect caveat. Do NOT merge to master — leave for Alex.

history.note: Pivoted from single-repo relay-loop (kept dead-ending) to a 3-repo portfolio loop around the anvil-as-shared-browser thesis. Flagship stream = wire DataFaucet capture to anvil (behind a flag, on a branch, prod untouched). Self-refilling.

Wrote flag-gated anvil backend for auto-scan (branch anvil-migration, prod-safe, tsc+build green). Found real bug: puppeteer.connect to anvil /cdp -> Target closed. Refilled syn-1b (fix the connect / version skew) + syn-1c (HAR-based capture fallback).

cdp-proxy buffer fix shipped (anvil 216d927) but puppeteer.connect still Target-closed. Pivoted strategy: VERIFIED anvil HAR capture works over pure REST (18 entries, no puppeteer.connect). Elevated syn-1c to the migration path, downgraded syn-1b, refilled syn-1d (nail HAR entry shape).

User hit "operation aborted due to timeout". Root cause: anvil REST /v1/scrape + navigate hardcoded networkidle2 (60s cap) which hangs on polling sites like HN. Fixed relay scrape() to navigate(domcontentloaded)+readCurrent and defaulted navigate to domcontentloaded. HN scrape 15s->1.1s. Worker restarted with fix. (Separately, Gemini free tier 429 quota from heavy testing — retry/backoff already handles it.)
Gemini free-tier quota exhausted on flash. Fix: default to -lite (higher cap) + automatic failover chain on 429 across independent-quota models. 3 tests. Worker restarted.
anvil HAR was flat; enhanced anvil (4271aeb) to include requestHeaders/requestBody/resourceType — verified live. Unblocks syn-1c (HAR-based DataFaucet capture now has headers+body).

HAR-based DataFaucet capture on anvil verified live end-to-end (jsonplaceholder, anvil mode, no Browserbase/puppeteer.connect). Core synergy works. Remaining: syn-2 (start/stop/debug routes + live-view), syn-3 (tests + PR), syn-1f (harden).
Extracted shared capture-filter lib + 7 tests (both backends now provably identical filtering). Gate 1769 green, build green, branch anvil-migration. Remaining: .env doc + PR description.
